mapper.select: SELECT item_code, item_name, spec, material, make_spec, drawing_ref, created_at, updated_at FROM item ORDER BY item_code
SELECT item_code, item_name, spec, material, make_spec, drawing_ref, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE item_code = #{itemCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item ( item_code, item_name, spec, material, make_spec, drawing_ref ) VALUES ( #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{spec}, #{material}, #{makeSpec}, #{drawingRef} )
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET item_name = #{itemName}, spec = #{spec}, material = #{material}, make_spec = #{makeSpec}, drawing_ref = #{drawingRef} WHERE item_code = #{itemCode}
